title: Data source Permissions tab Role picker only supports basic roles
answers: Why can't I select a custom RBAC role when adding a data source permission?
Can I assign a fixed/custom role in the data source Permissions tab?
What roles appear in the data source permission Role picker?
How do I grant data source access to users with custom RBAC roles?
body: The Permissions tab **Role** option for a data source only offers the basic org roles Viewer, Editor, Admin — custom and fixed RBAC roles never appear in that picker. This is enforced by `AddPermission.tsx` using the `OrgRole` enum, and by the backend resource-permissions API `POST .../builtInRoles/:builtInRole`, which only accepts basic role names. To grant access to a user/service account with a custom or fixed role, assign the permission directly to the user/service account/team, or grant `datasources:query` via RBAC — don't expect the Role dropdown to list custom roles.
applies: Grafana Enterprise/Cloud data source permissions UI and resource-permissions API for data sources
